title: Year 2 spelling check (20 words)
subject: English
source: Written for english/y2 lesson 106 (Year 2 end-of-year spelling check: 20 words in sentences (teacher-written, in the portal and printable))
intro: Lesson 106. Listen to each word in a sentence. Write the word.

blocks.answers: 1 children; 2 because; 3 people; 4 after; 5 water; 6 could; 7 every; 8 beautiful; 9 happily; 10 careful; 11 kindness; 12 sunflower; 13 knee; 14 wrote; 15 fixed; 16 running; 17 babies; 18 their; 19 there; 20 Monday

blocks.note: Teacher reads each word, then the sentence, then the word again: 1 children: The children played in the park. 2 because: I smiled because I was happy. 3 people: Many people came to the masjid. 4 after: We read after lunch. 5 water: Plants need water. 6 could: She could see the moon. 7 every: I read every night. 8 beautiful: The garden is beautiful. 9 happily: The cat purred happily. 10 careful: Be careful on the stairs. 11 kindness: Kindness makes people smile. 12 sunflower: The sunflower grew tall. 13 knee: I hurt my knee. 14 wrote: He wrote a letter. 15 fixed: Dad fixed the bike. 16 running: The boys were running fast. 17 babies: The babies were asleep. 18 their: They put on their coats. 19 there: The book is over there. 20 Monday: We start on Monday.
